name: Switch
summary: A single setting that takes effect immediately — on or off.
lead: ONE custom element — <aha-switch> — defined once, imported unchanged by React and Vue. Shadow-DOM CSS, themed only by --aha-* tokens; the track fills brand when checked and the knob slides. Emits a composed `change` CustomEvent<{checked}>. Zero drift — the same element, not two look-alikes.
codeNote: Same element, same shadow-DOM CSS → identical render. React (< 19) consumes it via a thin ref wrapper; Vue binds the custom element natively. The primitive is defined once in @ahaslides-product/design.

props.name: change
props.desc: Composed event on toggle; read e.detail.checked

opinion.note: Never mix switches and checkboxes in one group. The label names what the setting controls as a noun phrase; the switch communicates the action — don't prefix the label with Enable/Turn on.

snippets.note: The native form — a web component in an HTML file renders on open, no build step. The fast path for vibe-coding.
